name: plantdesk
description: 工場の設備・工事・点検・タスクを地図とつなぐ施設管理ワークスペース

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && node scripts/check-docs.mjs && npm run check:syntax
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test: npm test --prefix cloudflare && node tests/preferences.cjs && node tests/saas.cjs
scripts.test:ui: python3 tests/task_workspace_ui.py && python3 tests/team_operations_ui.py && python3 tests/workflow_ui.py
